Health and Fitness.

Now EXERCISE Under the Guidance of a Qualified SPORTS PHYSIOTHERAPIST.

We CUSTOMIZE EXERCISES keeping in mind that every individual is different and also focus on research based evidence.

Being a Doctor of Physical Therapy we design exercises based on individual strength and stamina and also customize exercises for people suffering from any medical condition (arthritis, spondylitis, pre-post surgery rehabilitation, etc).

Preparing Sportsman for individual sports and sports injury rehabilitation is where our interest lies.

For more details please contact us on drkevinagrawal@gmail.com or contact us on 9096212123.
